title: encasement mattress cover
text: encasement mattress cover. Purchased two of these, one queen, one full size.  Easy to install and looks like they will worth nicely... no crunching or other noise when you're sleeping on them.  Washed up nicely.  Arrived fast, I have prime, and in great condition.  Time and use will tell if they are the best, but right now I think they were a good price and worth it.  I haven't had any liquid accidents - yet - but it really looks like it would stop any liquid. Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review is helpful to you in some way!

product_metadata.title: PlushDeluxe Premium Mattress Encasement - Zippered Waterproof BedCover, 6-Sided Protection - Hypoallergenic Terry Fabric - Protects Against Dust, Critters - [9-12"] Depth King Size Mattress Protector
features: Covers All Six Sides - Keep your mattress clean, dry, and spotless on all sides. This waterproof mattress protector helps shield your cushion against dust, moisture, dirt, stains, or small critters.
A Snug, Secure Fit - Don't worry about this mattress cover getting removed on its own while you sleep. This is a zippered mattress protector, with the smooth zip closure hidden under a discreet flap.
Deep & Restful Sleep - Have you had it with bed covers that keep making scratchy noises whenever you move? Our bed protector is made of terry fabric that stays noiseless even while you toss and turn.
Gentle On Your Skin - Our hypoallergenic mattress cover meets OEKE-TEX quality standards. It's soft and smooth on your skin and is made without dyes or additives that can cause itching or irritation.

Customer Satisfaction – PlushDeluxe Mattress Protector works hard to ensure that they only carry top of the line products. However, if you have any issue at any time, please contact us, and we will be sure to resolve any issue right away.
